# X Corp

X Corp, headquartered in Bastrop, Texas, describes itself as a platform where "it's what's happening," offering breaking news and entertainment alongside sports and politics coverage with live commentary. The company's site emphasizes social discourse and real-time information sharing across multiple content categories.

The company was founded in 2023 and operates as a for-profit startup. According to held facts, X Corp has legal exposure in Texas, with 88 cases tracked in that jurisdiction. The site does not specify AI products or detail any specific technological offerings beyond its core platform functionality.
